title: Local Scoreboard
description: Scores and schedules for a set of followed teams, fully configurable to any city, teams and leagues

weather.title: Weather
weather.description: Current conditions, tonight's outlook and any active warnings, from the US National Weather Service. Free and keyless -- the same data the commercial services resell. Weather leads the strip: a warning is the one thing here more urgent than a live score.

label.title: Place Name
label.description: Shown above the temperature. Left empty, the nearest city name from the forecast office is used.

interval.title: Refresh (seconds)
interval.description: Fifteen minutes is ample; observations update hourly and forecasts less often.

hide_forecast_when_live.title: Hide Moon and Hourly Forecast While Any Game Is Live
hide_forecast_when_live.description: Off by default -- the moon phase and hourly forecast column stay up during a live game the same as always. Turning this on hides those two (current conditions and the 4-day forecast still show, on the same reasoning that keeps a warning visible) whenever any game is live, the same trigger that already hides leaderboards, award watch lists and countdowns.

kid_friendly.title: Kid-Friendly Mode
kid_friendly.description: Weather tips kids can use (Jacket / Umbrella), simpler football and soccer wording, a short Win! cheer after a followed team's final, plainer leaderboard titles, and occasional original pixel-art bumpers (rocket, dino, bot, kitty — handmade, not licensed characters). Aimed at a family board kids actually read.

fun_art.title: Fun Pixel Art
fun_art.description: Soft-shaded birds in flight (hawk, eagle, seagull, crow, goose, pelican, hummingbird). Handmade — not licensed characters.

enabled.title: Show Fun Art
enabled.description: Leave unset to follow Kid-Friendly Mode. Set true/false to force on or off.

flyers.title: Bird Flyovers
flyers.description: Every so often a soft-shaded bird in flight crosses with depth. On by default.

flyer_interval.title: Seconds Between Flyovers
flyer_interval.description: How often a bee or UFO appears (then it takes a couple of seconds to cross).

count.title: Extra Strip Bumpers
count.description: Optional wrecking characters baked into the scroll (0 = off, recommended). The bee/UFO flyover is usually enough.

screen_chaos.title: Cracked Window Overlay
screen_chaos.description: Optional smashed-glass overlay across the whole panel. Off by default — turn on only if you want the busier effect.

other_live_games.title: Other Live Games
other_live_games.description: Live games elsewhere that do not involve a followed team. Shown only while they are actually live; a final or a fixture for an unfollowed team never appears here.

limit.title: Maximum Games Shown
limit.description: Hard cap across every league after filtering. On a busy NFL Sunday, lower this if the strip feels crowded.

followed_leagues_only.title: Only Leagues You Follow
followed_leagues_only.description: When on, other-live games are limited to leagues that appear in your teams list (e.g. following only MLB+NBA skips NFL elsewhere). Off shows every league.

per_league_limit.title: Max Per League
per_league_limit.description: 0 means no per-league cap (only the overall maximum applies). Set to 1–3 to keep one sport from dominating the scroll on a busy day.

countdowns.title: Countdowns
countdowns.description: Days until a recurring annual date -- a birthday, a holiday -- shown on the strip right after the weather. Computed by plain date arithmetic, no network involved.

events.title: Dates
events.description: Each entry recurs every year on the same month and day.

limit.title: Maximum Shown
limit.description: The soonest this many, if more are configured.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: Strip scrolls one team at a time with everything about that team on a single pass: a full-height logo, any live game with its situation, finals, fixtures and standout performances. Cards shows one game at a time instead.

scroll_speed.title: Scroll Speed (pixels/second)
scroll_speed.description: Strip layout only. Lower is slower and easier to read.

rivalry_live_boost.title: Rivalry Live Extra Passes
rivalry_live_boost.description: Strip layout only. When a followed team is live against a configured rival, that game is drawn this many extra times in the scroll so it comes around more often (0 = no boost, 1 = shown twice per team pass).

rivalry_scroll_factor.title: Rivalry Live Scroll Factor
rivalry_scroll_factor.description: Strip layout only. While any followed rivalry game is live, multiply scroll speed by this factor (0.6 = 40% slower). 1 leaves speed unchanged.

static_panel.title: Fixed Live Panel
static_panel.description: Pins one team's live game to the leftmost module while everything else scrolls past it. A game you care about should not scroll away mid-at-bat.

priority.title: Priority Order
priority.description: Which team's live game takes the module when several are playing at once. First match wins; if none are playing the module is released and everything scrolls.

alternate.title: Alternate Bottom Row (seconds)
alternate.description: The last row swaps between the situation and the players involved, because sixty-four pixels will not hold both at once.

leaderboards.title: League Leaderboards
leaderboards.description: Season leaders ride on the same strip as the scores, so one board shows both without the rotation handing between two plugins.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Shown in this order, after the teams.

scope.title: League Split
scope.description: Per league by default: an AL home run race and an NL one are different stories, and merging them hides both.

depth.title: Players Per Category
depth.description: Three fits a segment: a title over three ranked rows.

cache_duration.title: Leader Cache (seconds)
cache_duration.description: Season totals move slowly; six hours is plenty.

awards.title: Award Watch Lists
awards.description: Computed from the leaderboards with a weighted points system. Not predictions or betting odds.

teams.title: Teams To Follow
teams.description: Each entry needs an ESPN abbreviation and a league. Common alternate spellings are matched automatically, so NYK and NY both find the Knicks.

league.title: League
league.description: laliga is Spain's top flight only, not every competition a club plays -- ESPN organises soccer one competition at a time rather than one feed per club.

rivals.title: Rivals
rivals.description: ESPN abbreviations that flag a game as a rivalry -- coloured and labelled differently on the strip regardless of whether it is live, final, or upcoming.

favorite_player.title: Favorite Player
favorite_player.description: Optional. Shown on that team's strip as a Star note (e.g. Lamine Yamal for Barcelona). When they appear in a game's scorers or notables, they are preferred for the performer highlight.

max_display_duration.title: Max Seconds Per Visit
max_display_duration.description: Longest this plugin holds the panel before handing back. It resumes at the next game on its following turn.

live_interval.title: Refresh While Live (seconds)
live_interval.description: How often to refetch while a followed team is playing -- balls, strikes and score change every few seconds, so this stays far below the idle cadence.

idle_interval.title: Refresh When Idle (seconds)
idle_interval.description: How often to check for a live game starting up when nothing is currently in progress.

show_leaders.title: Show Notable Player
show_leaders.description: A line under the score with the game's standout performer and their stat line. Needs a wide panel.
